decision.reason: The pair (e,u) is local_defect plus the complementary cell gap. Even-cell position does not change J. Small odd defects on n<=1e5 are odd squares together with n=3 (e=2) and n=5 (e=4). Those isolated defects do not force the next gap to be small. Exact consecutive hits are monochrome towers. The same word admits generic and near-boundary realizers. Hard starts are not concentrated at the floor walls.
